title: shikumi.lock entry
description:
one line of the lock: an artifact of one ecosystem, tagged with the ecosystem's name. each
variant's tag is `Ecosystem`'s name for the variant `ecosystem` maps it to, which a test holds.

oneOf.description: a toolchain source, fetched from `url` and unpacked, whose tree has the NAR hash `narHash`.

ToolchainSource.description: a source tree Shikumi's own Nix needs.
